sentence: A guessing game where one randomly picked chat member secretly chooses another member, and the rest ask up to 20 yes or no questions or guess who it is.
use_when: The group wants a quick guessing game about people in the chat
Someone asks for 20 questions or a who-is-it game
A group in a car or waiting around needs a simple word-free party game
dont_use_when: The group wants to guess an object, animal, or word that is not a chat member
Only one person is available, since it needs a holder and at least one guesser
The group wants a vote, poll, or scored trivia quiz
